done_when: An overloaded SDK session message is rejected as busy and an overloaded delegated follow-up is retried instead of marked delivered, proven by tests

findings.body: Both promised behaviors have only mocked unit proof. This test supplies `overloaded` followed by `enqueued` and calls recovery manually against MemoryAsyncTaskRepository; the SDK test at apps/core/test/unit/application/sessions/session-interaction-module.test.ts:358 similarly supplies an overloaded publication result. Neither exercises a full Postgres backlog through the real entry point, and no corresponding end-to-end case exists. docs/review-instructions.md:30–35 requires real-runtime/Postgres proof for Done-when behaviors. Add owner-boundary tests proving that the SDK endpoint returns the busy rejection and that recovery retains an overloaded delegated follow-up, then admits it after capacity becomes available. The successful close run does not fill this coverage gap.
